rows.title: Store and price-drop words both required
rows.test: 'target run tomorrow $40' is not a claim

rows.title: From and to
rows.defect: the comma is not removed from the old price
rows.test: $1,049.99 to $899.99 parses with the thousands comma

rows.title: Two amounts without from/to
rows.defect: the amounts are taken in the order written
rows.test: the higher is paid, the lower is now

rows.title: Not lower is no claim
rows.defect: only a higher price is refused
rows.test: an equal price is not lower

rows.title: Missing prices are asked
rows.defect: a missing price counts as zero

rows.title: Only that store's charges
rows.defect: any store's charge can be the purchase
rows.test: a Walmart charge is not the Target purchase

rows.title: Pending and foreign rows out
rows.defect: pending rows and other currencies count
rows.test: a pending and a euro charge are not the purchase

rows.title: Up to 12% tax
rows.defect: any amount over the old price matches
rows.test: 13% over the old price is not a match

rows.title: The named day picks the row
rows.defect: the named day is ignored and the latest fitting charge is taken

rows.title: Several on one day are asked
rows.defect: the first of several is taken silently

rows.title: Inside the window
rows.defect: the age is counted from the first of the month

rows.title: Past the window
rows.defect: the window allows one extra day

rows.title: Best Buy's return period
rows.defect: a non-number window is shown as an N-day window

rows.title: Exclusions from the term note
rows.defect: the term note is never said

rows.title: A stale term is said
rows.test: an old Costco term may have changed
